name: legiflare
description: Write privacy policies, terms of service, cookie and refund policies from what your product actually does, and publish them on Legiflare at a public URL.

interface.shortDescription: Legal documents written from your code, published at a public URL
interface.longDescription: Reads your code to find the analytics, ads, payment, sign-in and AI services you use, writes a privacy policy, terms of service, cookie or refund policy that matches, and publishes it on Legiflare. Updates keep the same URL.
defaultPrompt: Write a privacy policy for this app and publish it on Legiflare.
Are my legal documents still up to date with this code?
